title: Act: Add historyStatus state and loading message to ContributionSheet
summary: Track history load status and render loading text
description: Add a historyStatus state ('loading'|'ready'|'error') set by the history effect and render a loading status message in the history area.
acceptance_criteria: historyStatus is 'loading' when the effect starts and 'ready' after listMine resolves
'Loading your suggestions…' renders while loading and the list renders only when not loading

steps.action: Add a historyStatus state typed 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' initialised to 'loading', and a reloadKey number state initialised to 0.
steps.code:
const [historyStatus, setHistoryStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);
steps.expected: Component compiles with the two new states.

steps.action: Call setHistoryStatus('loading') right after the early return guard, call setHistoryStatus('ready') inside the then handler after the cancelled check, and add reloadKey to the dependency array.
steps.expected: Status is loading while listMine is pending and ready after it resolves.

steps.action: Before the ul, render a loading paragraph when historyStatus === 'loading', and render the ul only when historyStatus !== 'loading'.
steps.expected: Loading text visible while pending, list shown after.
